announcement.title: Enrollment for Semester 2 is Now Open
announcement.content: All currently enrolled students may now process their enrollment for the Second Semester, AY 2024-2025. Visit the Registrar's Office or log in to the Student Portal. Deadline is on September 30, 2024.
announcement.author: Admin User

announcement.title: Web Development Workshop – Registration Open
announcement.content: Slots are now open for the Web Development Workshop on September 10. Only 40 seats available. Register through CampusHub before they run out!
announcement.author: Admin User

announcement.title: Library System Maintenance – August 20
announcement.content: The online library system will be unavailable on August 20, 2024 from 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM due to scheduled maintenance. Please plan your research activities accordingly.
announcement.author: Admin User

announcement.title: Reminder: ID Renewal Deadline – August 31
announcement.content: Students whose IDs expire this semester must renew at the Student Affairs Office. Bring 2 valid IDs and 1 passport-size photo. The deadline for renewal is August 31, 2024.
announcement.author: Admin User

announcement.title: Campus Cultural Night – Performers Wanted!
announcement.content: We are looking for student performers for the Campus Cultural Night on October 20. Interested? Submit your group name and act description to the Student Council office by September 15.
announcement.author: Admin User
